items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I went to the guy -- I went to Mickey Baker, Sam Taylor, Ernie Hays, Lloyd Trotman, and I said to them, I said, 'Well, look, man, why can't we start a record company of our own?' ... you and Ernie Hays... we worked

ctx.x: He was the background. You were the drummer.
I was the drummer. Ernie Hays was on piano.
Sam Taylor was a hot tenor player and Lloyd Trotman was one of the base players.
